pain_points.text: Budget changes not entered in pacing sheet; tracker paces against wrong number; overspend paid by agency
pain_points.quote: The budget would change and they wouldn't update the sheet. So the trackers are tracking. but it's on the wrong number.

pain_points.text: LinkedIn had no pacing tracker
pain_points.quote: I probably should set up a pacing track with the LinkedIn and then bang, this happens.
pain_points.matches_existing_problem: Budgets maintained by hand in three places; LinkedIn not tracked → $10K overspend

pain_points.text: Processes and SOPs built but not followed or read
pain_points.source: interviewee (Joe, B); Austin's Notion stats agree
pain_points.quote: you can build all the best processes in the world but nobody actually follows them.
pain_points.matches_existing_problem: Documentation is stale and rarely read

pain_points.text: Founder repeatedly re-explains how to do things
pain_points.quote: I'm sick of just explaining the same thing over and over again.

pain_points.text: Reminders go out but updates don't follow
pain_points.source: interviewee (Joe, B); Austin observed the same
pain_points.quote: Half an hour ago, the reminder went out. We still don't have updates.
pain_points.matches_existing_problem: Reminders go unacted; a broken reminder bot went unnoticed

pain_points.text: Leadership can't see whether work is happening, especially on remote days
pain_points.quote: And that's the day people, the days people are in the office. What about the days everyone's at home?
pain_points.matches_existing_problem: new

pain_points.text: Culture of 'make the mistake and ask forgiveness' rather than fixing root causes
pain_points.quote: make the mistake and ask for forgiveness first, rather than just fix the root cause.
pain_points.matches_existing_problem: new

pain_points.text: Escalations go to Head of Client Services, not department leads
pain_points.impact: Julia's time (4–16 h/month, assumed); slower fixes
pain_points.quote: I would love for them to be involved on the escalation processes, but I don't think they've got the soft skills yet
pain_points.matches_existing_problem: Escalations route around department leads to the Head of Client Services

pain_points.text: Department leads promoted into management without people-leadership experience
pain_points.quote: they've only been in management since they've been with us. They've been all promoted into those roles.
pain_points.matches_existing_problem: new

pain_points.text: Sales commits scope and ad spend that isn't profitable or feasible
pain_points.source: interviewer raised first (Austin); Joe agreed strongly
pain_points.quote: we can't be promising all of these things and including them in the scope when like it's not even going to be profitable
pain_points.matches_existing_problem: Sales commits to work delivery can't profitably do

pain_points.text: Founder still pulled into building deal strategies and ad-spend numbers
pain_points.quote: So I'm still getting involved in a lot of that, but I don't want to
pain_points.matches_existing_problem: new (related: Sales commits to work delivery can't profitably do)

pain_points.text: Ad-spend calculator exists but isn't used consistently on sales calls
pain_points.quote: I'm trying to encourage [the sales lead] to use this instead of just pulling numbers out of his Backside.
pain_points.matches_existing_problem: Sales commits to work delivery can't profitably do

pain_points.text: Publishers remove paid links after payment; nobody checks they're still live
pain_points.quote: we don't have a way to currently check whether these are dropping off

pain_points.text: Links copied by hand from tracker into CRM for reporting

pain_points.matches_existing_problem: Link building runs on 7+ disconnected spreadsheets

pain_points.text: Link-building admin still on sheets; no capacity to improve it
pain_points.quote: there's stuff that we just can't do at the moment because we just don't have the manpower.

pain_points.text: No early warning of churn risk; six-year client lost after poor feedback
pain_points.quote: I've also just had like some bad feedback from clients who are now not with us anymore. And as a client has been with us for like six years.
pain_points.matches_existing_problem: No proactive performance alerting – problems found at month-end (partial; churn-trigger angle new)

pain_points.text: Account data not pre-synthesised; consultants review ad accounts by hand, capping clients per head

pain_points.quote: rather than people having to synthesize that information by going onto the ad account, reviewing all the stats
pain_points.matches_existing_problem: No proactive performance alerting – problems found at month-end

pain_points.text: Growth depends on hiring; each hire feels like a risk
pain_points.quote: So when I keep hiring people, I feel like I'm just taking a little bit of risk.
pain_points.matches_existing_problem: Managers at capacity – Tier 2/3 clients get dropped first

pain_points.text: Pushing for higher performance risks attrition
pain_points.quote: now with this next generation, they just quit, man.
pain_points.matches_existing_problem: new

pain_points.text: Call transcripts (Otter) paid for but only the Founder uses them
pain_points.quote: It's basically just like a data backup. I think I'm the only one that does anything with the transcripts.

pain_points.text: SEO revenue per employee hard to lift because value is human writing

pain_points.matches_existing_problem: new
